method: Native navigator.getGamepads() in headed Chrome on a temporary local play session. The pilot pressed real controls. The trace records hardware state beside game mode, visible panels and focused controls. Playback was not injected.

observations.firstPointerTarget: game-canvas, used to activate the Chrome window
observations.nestedNavigation: left stick moved focus to flight settings; A opened it; B restored its opener; B resumed flight
observations.quickMenu: raw button 10 opened pause panel; B resumed flight
observations.titleReturn: A activated the focused return to title button
observations.directionalPad: raw axis 9 contained four cardinal inputs and diagonal transitions; matching decode has unit coverage
observations.flight: left stick produced nonzero roll in flight
